name: Custom Shape Wooden Rotating Books Read Counter
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Made from high-quality natural wood with a sturdy layered structure. The main panels and rotating number rings are crafted from wood with precise thickness (3mm–5mm depending on the layer), ensuring durability and a premium handcrafted feel.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in two main sizes:
    6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Compact base design allows the product to stand firmly on desks, bookshelves, or nightstands.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    UV printing technology is used for both front and back sides, delivering vivid colors, sharp details, and long-lasting images that do not fade easily over time.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    This rotating wooden counter also serves as a stylish decorative piece for desks, bookshelves, reading corners, libraries and home offices.
    - Books Tracker: Perfect for tracking the number of books read throughout the year, making reading goals more visual and motivating.
    - Fitness Tracker: Can be used to count running or walking miles, workout sessions, or fitness challenges over days, months, or years.
    - Hobby Tracker: Ideal for tracking personal hobbies such as the number of fish caught, projects completed, or achievements reached within a year.
    - Daily / Time Tracker: Suitable for counting days, months, or years for habits, routines, countdowns, or personal milestones.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift for book lovers, students, teachers, readers, and families. This rotating wooden counter is suitable for all occasions, including birthdays, Christmas, back-to-school gifts, anniversaries, New Year, and year-end celebrations.
    - Its customizable design makes it a unique and personal gift that encourages goal tracking, motivation, and positive daily habits, while also serving as a charming decorative piece for any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Wooden Rotating Books Read Counter

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
